items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was just thinking, there wasn't any music to tell Hackie what to do, huh? He was clowning. [INTERVIEWEE] He's clowning, he's clowning.

ctx.x: Did Ruby's show play honky ton once in a while? No, no. No, he didn't play no back in the field now. Did they do, when they had show up there, did they used to accompany the show? Did they accompany the show? Huh? Did they accompany the show? He played music for the show. For the show, yeah. From the music? Yeah. From the sheet music right there, reading? Oh yeah, music, that. All he used was sheet music. Oh, I see. All he was going to have to achieve was the drummer. Or the drummer, huh.
I was just thinking, there wasn't any music to tell Hackie what to do, huh? He was clowning.
He's clowning, he's clowning. All he wanted to do was the band start. He got it.
